stage: 4L14 Fullscreen focus, native window notifications and lost-device recovery
changes: API8 fullscreen subscribes to the focus window separately from its output, retains original styles and native message ordering, restores display mode/minimizes the output on loss, and waits for actual focus recovery before allowing Reset. Present no longer steals foreground for API8.

On XP, thread-level activation while the focus window is minimized does not recover the device. If restoring foreground sends only WM_ACTIVATE, the subscription reconciles that lost-to-active edge and forwards the ordered output-position/application activation notification.

Subscriptions and hooks retain callback storage independently of COM devices. A/W forwarding, nested callbacks, shared subscriptions, app-replaced window procedures, destroyed windows and rollback are covered with production C under ASan/UBSan.

The browser test runner awaits asynchronous profile deletion on startup failure and returns a close promise through the live-renderer facade. The Wine harness awaits it even when assertions throw. Real Chrome checks cover normal completion, caller failure and startup timeout.
